description.value: Greendale Acres is a family-operated farm attraction that opened Canada's first corn maze in 1999 and has grown into a multi-season destination featuring tulip and flower fields, a corn maze, a farm shop, orchard cider, and live music events including the annual Chilliwack Corn Festival. The farm sits on a historic old dairy property in the Fraser Valley and is now run by the founding family's third generation, who host school groups, corporate events, and large seasonal festivals. Touring cyclists exploring the agricultural back roads near Chilliwack will find it a distinctive, authentically local stop.
